text:
Sara (Sales): Hey team — RFP from Mistral Systems landed, key asks: private VPC, HSM/KMS integration, SLA 99.9, PO C for embeddings + chat, latency targets <120ms P95 for short responses, and they want a capability matrix + pricing tiers. attaching their RFI spreadsheet.

Mike (Solutions): Thanks. Can we confirm target QPS and sample payload sizes? Also they asked about quantized model options and expected quality tradeoffs. I can draft a POC runbook if we lock scope.

Diego (Mistral): Hi Sara — goal is 200 QPS peak for embeddings, ~50 QPS for chat. avg prompt tokens ~60, response tokens ~40. We need HSM for key wrapping, and must demonstrate private deploy (VPC) + audit logs.

Rebecca (Security): Noted. We'll need full RFI answers for crypto controls, key rotation, SOC2/HIPAA attachments. @Sara please share the specific questionnaire sheet row IDs. I'll start with the KMS/HSM integration section.

Mike (Solutions): Draft POC plan: 1) Dedicated private cluster in our staging VPC 2) Import customer cert + KMS test keys (HSM stub) 3) Run perf tests (100/200/300 QPS) 4) Run quality evals on their prompt set 5) Rollout checklist + fallback to hosted variant. Timeline ~2 weeks prep + 1 week POC. Thoughts? :+1:

Nate (Product): For quantization: we can offer int8 and int4 variants. int4 lowers memory & cost ~2.5x but expect small fluency regressions on long-context summarization. For chat w/ short prompts it should be fine. I'll add recommended model variants to the capability matrix.

Mike (Solutions): Sample config snippet for the POC nodes (for infra team):

```
redwood_deploy:
  mode: private
  vpc_peering: enabled
  node_type: a10g
  quant_profile: int8
  kms: hsm-stub
```

Sara (Sales): Diego — attaching our draft capability matrix and a sample quote PDF: "mistral_capmatrix_v1.xlsx" and "mistral_quote_tiered.pdf". Can you confirm which compliance docs they need in addition to SOC2/HIPAA?

Diego (Mistral): They specifically asked for penetration test dates, SOC2 Type II report, and a copy of our subcontractor list. Also want pricing for both reserved (Dedicated) and burst (Hosted fallback).

Jen (Legal): Heads-up — if they require subcontractor lists we need an NDA amendment. Also they requested a 12-month data retention SLO — legal will need to review.

Rebecca (Security): I uploaded the security attachments we can share: "soc2_summary.pdf", "pen-test-2025.pdf" and an HSM integration note. We'll answer the questionnaire sections: crypto, logging, access controls.

Mike (Solutions): Quick pricing note: Dedicated monthly commit to hit 200 QPS embeddings + 50 QPS chat estimated at $XXk/mo (draft). Hosted fallback for spikes billed per-token; recommend a burst cap policy. I'll add numbers to the quote.

Sara (Sales): Next actions: Mike -> finalize POC runbook + perf matrix; Rebecca -> RFI answers for security + attach docs; Nate -> add quant/variant guidance to matrix; Jen -> flag any contract changes. I'll consolidate and send Mistral a single packet by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline check: no blocked pipelines for branch "mistral-rfp". CI green.

Diego (Mistral): Appreciated — we'll review the packet and circle back with preferred POC dates. Thanks all. :pray:
